0022600018.text: The Philadelphia 76ers, 4-1 and first in the Atlantic, host the New York Knicks, 2-3 and eighth in the East, in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game, the 76ers' sixth of the season. Philadelphia has won four of its last five and is on a one-game winning streak, while New York has won its last two. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness), Jaylen Brown (knee), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle, sprain), and the 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 106-100 win in New York on October 20.
